target_customer: B2B sales teams that use a CRM
problem: Salespeople spend time on email follow ups and CRM data entry instead of selling.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI sales agents
product_category: AI sales agent and CRM automation

founders.name: Gaurav Aggarwal
founders.background_notes: Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree per the YC page.

founders.name: Anuja Verma
founders.background_notes: About a decade at Amazon across transaction and risk, Alexa and AWS.

technical_complexity.rationale: Pre-LLM wave in mid 2022, automating email and CRM tasks needed integrations and NLP, moderately hard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: CRM vendors and revenue intelligence tools could build the same automations, and LLMs later commoditized it.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Salesforce brought the team in July 2025 to work on Agentforce.

market_need_then: CRM data entry is a known sales complaint; no dated 2022 source was retrieved in this run.

branding.domain_note: Used truva.ai; the domain did not resolve from the session network.

identity.voice_and_tone: Pitched as an AI sales agent or sidekick for sales teams.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; the name collides with other companies called Truva and Trouva.

outcome_analysis: Truva joined YC in Summer 2022 building AI agents for sales workflows, closed a roughly 4 million seed in May 2024 and had its team join Salesforce in July 2025 to work on Agentforce. The rise of generative AI agents gave the team value to an incumbent CRM, though the product was easy for platform vendors to replicate and price is undisclosed.
notes: Seed 4M from Entrepreneur India (2024-05-22) and VCBacked; CB Insights total of 4.5M is consistent. Persana reports a 3M seed led by Stellaris and BounceWatch a 500K pre-seed; both unverified and not recorded. Search results about Series A rounds in late 2025 and 2026 belong to a different company named Truva and were excluded. Website did not resolve from the session network. Only 'team joins Salesforce' is sourced, so this may be an acquihire. No dated 2022 competitor sources found.
